title: Qualify the retained hinge fixture candidate
requires: Blender exporter toolchain; CUDA reference device
scope: Recreate the retained five-body functional hinge asset from authored source and qualify the export through the public API without importing its archived golden.
acceptance: Record reviewed .blend and exported .glb hashes, topology, material and constraint semantics; verify the export with the Blender scene tests.
Run settling, steering and complete-rotation behavior on CUDA; generate a fresh same-revision golden only if the reviewed fixture remains a valid conformance case.
evidence: PASS: Blender 4.5.2 current exporter reproduced candidate GLB sha256 80a5f22de8c7662397d7405eff6720232389e5163fd12dc586b39deb9f784e7b; 33 exporter tests passed with 1 skipped; docs/roadmap/evidence/F6-09-hinge-fixture-qualification.json
PASS: CUDA settling and steering, 2400 frames each, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU driver 590.44.01; tracked metrics in docs/roadmap/evidence/F6-09-hinge-fixture-qualification.json

RESULT: candidate rejected after 13.1578-radian full rotation produced 41.4778 mm gear overlap against a 2 mm limit; no asset or golden promoted; docs/roadmap/evidence/F6-09-hinge-fixture-qualification.json
